sections.heading: Daily Operations Summary - 04-Mar-2015
sections.content:
00:00-03:00 (3.00 hrs): With PROPESA company unit and test plug (VETCO GRAY) tested lower preventer 13-5/8"-10M variable ram 4 1/2"-7" + upper preventer variable ram 4 1/2"-7" and blind with 500PSI low and 8000PSI high, 15 min each test, successful.

04:00-05:00 (1.00 hr): VETCO GRAY company installed wear bushing to 13 5/8" 10-M wellhead.
05:00-09:00 (4.00 hrs): Connected PDC bit 10-5/8" type MDSi813 S/N: JJ1604 + POWER DRIVE + MWD. Applied torque to bit of 47,800 FT-LBS.
09:00-17:00 (8.00 hrs): Continued assembling directional BHA, SLB-D&M personnel installed MWD rod, connected Monel DC 8" + bottom filter and performed surface test of directional tool with 380 GPM and 1,350 PSI with 2.05 GR/CC density mud, successful. Connected stabilizer 8" X 10-1/2" + RHINO reamer with VCP and performed non-opening test of reamer blocks with 380 GPM, 1400 PSI, successful. Connected DC 8 + stabilizer 8" X 10-1/2" + 6 X DC 8" + jar 8" + 3 X DC 8" + combination 6-5/8" REG X NC 50 + 5 stands of HWDP 5" and put in at 278 M.
17:00-00:00 (7.00 hrs): Ran PDC bit 10 5/8" and directional string equipped with P.DRIVE / MWD / RHINO reamer, by stands of TP 5" S-135, 19.5 # from 278 M to 1,580 M. Filling well every 500 M for carrying VCP, kept displacement control with sheet and trip tank. Running speed 5 MIN/STAND.
